Promaster Tough

Field · 40–42mm · 200–300m · solar · 2019–2026

The Promaster Tough is a family of highly durable field watches designed for adventurous use. Its defining features include a shock-resistant and often monocoque (one-piece) case construction, light-powered Eco-Drive movement, and the use of hardened materials like Super Titanium.

The story

Introduced as part of the Promaster collection in the late 1990s, the 'Tough' series gained a following for its robust, no-nonsense design. Early models became famous through their association with British survivalist Ray Mears, cementing their reputation as reliable outdoor tools. The design has evolved from the original titanium models to include stainless steel versions with proprietary surface-hardening technology. Across generations, the core principles of high durability, legible dials, and a maintenance-free Eco-Drive movement have remained constant, making it a go-to choice for a rugged, everyday watch.
